description: The plot illustrates the relationship between co-occurrence number and ACC (%). The x-axis is labeled “Co-occurrence Number” and is scaled logarithmically, ranging from 1 to 10<sup>3</sup>, with tick labels at 10<sup>0</sup>, 10<sup>1</sup>, 10<sup>2</sup>, and 10<sup>3</sup>. The y-axis is labeled “ACC (%)” and is scaled linearly, ranging from 60 to 80, with tick labels at 60, 65, 70, 75, and 80. A black solid line with circular markers represents “Base”, starting at approximately 60% at a co-occurrence number of 1 and increasing to approximately 67% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>3</sup>. A brown dashed line with diamond markers represents “MEND”, beginning at approximately 64% at a co-occurrence number of 1 and rising to approximately 72% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>3</sup>. A blue solid line with triangular markers represents “FT”, starting at approximately 62% at a co-occurrence number of 1 and increasing to approximately 68% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>3</sup>. A purple dashed line with square markers represents “MEMIT”, beginning at approximately 67% at a co-occurrence number of 1 and rising to approximately 73% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>3</sup>. A red solid line with downward-pointing triangular markers represents “IKE”, starting at approximately 65% at a co-occurrence number of 1 and increasing to approximately 69% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>3</sup>. A green solid line with square markers represents “ROME”, beginning at approximately 72% at a co-occurrence number of 1 and rising to approximately 76% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>3</sup>.
